name: Black Dragon’s Acid Tongue
body:
You gain the black dragon’s ability to speak with reptiles.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic bloodline (must choose black dragon), 1st-level dragon disciple

Benefit: You gain the constant spell-like ability to speak with reptiles. This functions as speak with animals, but only with reptilian animals. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus to Diplomacy checks against reptiles and dragons.
